jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
We're reimagining enterprise Identity and Access Management from the ground up. Founded by serial entrepreneurs Shai Morag and Tal Marom and backed by a $60M seed round from Greylock, Accel, and CRV, we're building the next generation of identity security. Identity is the gateway to everything- who's let in, who's kept out, and it's now the number one attack vector in the enterprise. The tools built to govern it were designed for a slower world of human users and static environments. That world is gone. Identities are exploding across human, machine, and AI agents faster than legacy systems can track, and security teams are left patching together five disconnected tools that still can't answer "who has access to what, right now." We think the answer isn't another point solution- it's a new foundation. Oak is the AI-native Identity Operating System: an AI connector framework that reaches any application, a live identity graph built from raw evidence, and a team of AI agents that governs the full lifecycle of every identity in one platform. We're building Oak's AI-native core from day one-engineered for what enterprise identity is becoming, not patched onto what it used to be. And we're just getting started.

About the Role:

We are looking for a high-ownership Product Manager to take full end-to-end responsibility for a core domain within Oak's platform. Reporting to a Director of Product, you will bridge the gap between customer discovery and technical R&D execution to ship market-ready, AI-native identity solutions at speed.


What you will Do:

• Own a product domain end-to-end within Oak's platform, driving it from zero to a shipped, market-ready capability.

• Lead structured discovery: conduct customer interviews, engage with industry analysts and IAM/IGA consultants, and synthesize findings into sharp problem definitions and opportunity sizing.

• Map the competitive landscape across identity governance, NHI management, and adjacent security tooling to identify differentiated positioning for your domain.

• Translate discovery into a clear product strategy and roadmap, making deliberate prioritization decisions backed by evidence from the market and Oak's identity graph data.

• Partner closely with R&D throughout the full build cycle - from shaping requirements and reviewing designs to driving execution and managing trade-offs under real delivery constraints.

• Work hand-in-hand with GTM teams to define go-to-market strategy, equip sales and marketing with the right positioning, and ensure a tight feedback loop from the field back into the roadmap.

What you will bring:

 - 8+ years of product management experience in cybersecurity, with a track record of shipping features that address real security or compliance challenges.

 - Proven, hands-on experience in the identity space – IAM, IGA, PAM, or related domains – with a demonstrated track record of shipping identity-focused capabilities.

 - Technically fluent enough to work shoulder-to-shoulder with R&D – able to translate complex identity, access, or security concepts into clear product requirements without losing fidelity.

 - Strong business acumen and strategic thinking: you connect product decisions to market opportunity, customer pain, and revenue impact, not just feature output.

 - Comfortable owning the full product lifecycle independently from discovery through delivery.

 - Confident, polished communicator in English who can lead customer-facing meetings, run discovery sessions, and present roadmaps to technical and executive audiences alike.

 - Able to hold ambiguity and make principled trade-offs in a fast-moving environment where IAM, IGA, and NHI security demands are evolving rapidly.

Nice to have:

 - Hands-on experience with JIT access or Non-Human Identities (NHIs) specifically.

 - Background in a technical customer-facing role (e.g., Solutions Architecture or Cyber Consulting).
